ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The diagram shows a 5 ft by 5 ft square on the right. A circle is attached on the left so that the square's left vertical side is also the circle's vertical diameter. The square is shaded gray except for the part covered by the right semicircle of the circle. The left semicircle extends outside the square and is unshaded. Reasoning: The square side length is 5 ft, so the circle diameter is 5 ft and the radius is 2.5 ft. The square area is 5 × 5 = 25 square feet. The part of the circle inside the square is a semicircle with area (1/2)π(2.5)^2 = 3.125π ≈ 9.8175. The shaded area is the square area minus this semicircle: 25 − 9.8175 ≈ 15.1825. The total selectable area shown is the union of the square and the circle: the square plus the left semicircle outside the square, so 25 + 9.8175 ≈ 34.8175. The probability is shaded area divided by total area: 15.1825 / 34.8175 ≈ 0.4361, which rounds to 0.44.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as showing the entire unshaded circle plus the gray part of the square as the full sample region. From the text, the circle has diameter 5 ft and radius 2.5 ft; the square has area 25 square feet. Instead of finding the gray area first, compute the complement: the unshaded part of the total figure is the whole circle, area π(2.5)^2. 图像描述：图中有一个正方形，右侧和大部分内部区域被灰色阴影填充。正方形的左边是一条竖直线，这条线同时也是一个圆的直径；圆在正方形左侧伸出，并且圆的右半部分进入正方形内部但没有阴影。图中顶部标出正方形一边为 5 ft，右侧也标出正方形高度为 5 ft。因此正方形边长为 5 ft，圆的直径为 5 ft，半径为 2.5 ft。

按指定方法，把随机选点的总区域看作正方形与圆组成的并集，即灰色部分加上整个未阴影圆。正方形面积为 5^2 = 25。圆面积为 π(2.5)^2 = 6.25π。总区域不是正方形面积加整个圆面积，因为圆的右半部分在正方形内重叠；总区域等于正方形面积加上正方形外面的半圆面积：25 + (1/2)π(2.5)^2 = 25 + 3.125π。指定方法用补集计算：未阴影部分是整个圆，面积为 6.25π。所以阴影概率 = 1 - 圆面积 / 总区域面积 = 1 - 6.25π / (25 + 3.125π)。数值约为 1 - 19.63495 / 34.81748 = 0.43617，四舍五入到百分位为 0.44。
